Til We See the Shore
is the debut studio album by
Christian alternative rock
band
Seabird
.  The album was released on June 24, 2008
[
1
]
and contains material from their first two EPs,
Spread Your Broken Wings and Try
and
Let Me Go On
.  The album also spawned the band's first single, "Rescue".
